_comment: Authoritative source for the two scheduled jobs' prompts and tool allowlists.
These live in ~/.openclaw/state/openclaw.sqlite at runtime; this file is what they
are supposed to say. The prompts are prose the model obeys, exactly like a SKILL.md,
so server/test/skill-references.test.ts lints them for dead CLI verbs and unknown
tool names. That lint is the reason this file exists: the pre-migration
'/usr/local/bin/obsidian' reference survived here long after every SKILL.md was
Delivery targets (channel/recipient) are deliberately NOT stored here - they are
personal contact details, and they are not prose the model reads.
Replace <skills-dir> with the absolute path of this checkout and <...-job-id> with the ids
from `openclaw cron list`, then apply with: openclaw cron edit <id> --message '<message>' --tools '<tools>'

jobs.name: Daily Second Brain Standup
jobs.message: Run the user's daily standup by following the standup skill exactly — it is the authoritative workflow: data sources, reconciliation rules, staleness only from dated evidence, standup shape, and the Standup.md update. Read the skill first at <skills-dir>/standup/SKILL.md, and the shared conventions at <skills-dir>/second-brain/SKILL.md. All vault access is the obsidian__* MCP tools — there is no CLI and no shell fallback; if a tool errors, its message names the fix, so act on it or report plainly rather than finding another way in. Vault 'Obsidian Vault' at ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault/. Deliver the concise standup to this channel. Read-mostly: write only Standup.md, via obsidian__standup_write; do not mutate task or project state. If this message and the skill ever disagree, the skill wins.

jobs.name: Nightly Consolidation
jobs.message: Run the nightly consolidation pass for the user's Obsidian second brain by following the nightly-consolidation skill exactly — it is the authoritative workflow: git snapshots around writes, change window from the newest Syntheses/ note, inbox routing as write-to-destination-then-remove, entity wikilinking limits and exclusion zones, idempotent re-runs, Related links with one-line reasons, MOC upkeep, and a synthesis note only when there is something real to say. Read the skill first at <skills-dir>/nightly-consolidation/SKILL.md, the shared Edit Policy at <skills-dir>/second-brain/SKILL.md, and the KB review steps at <skills-dir>/knowledge-base/SKILL.md. All vault access is the obsidian__* MCP tools — there is no CLI and no shell fallback; if a tool errors, its message names the fix, so act on it or report plainly rather than finding another way in. Vault 'Obsidian Vault' at ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault/. Reply with a concise summary: items routed, links added, observations, candidates, and anything that failed or was skipped. If this message and the skill ever disagree, the skill wins.
